title.zh: 列举存储空间冗余类型转换任务
title.en: List bucket data redundancy type conversion tasks

descriptions.zh:
- 要列举Bucket下所有的存储冗余转换任务，您必须具有`oss:ListBucketDataRedundancyTransition`权限。具体操作，请参见[为RAM用户授权自定义的权限策略](~~199058~~)。
- 每个地域都有对应的访问域名（Endpoint）。关于地域与访问域名对应关系的更多信息，请参见[访问域名和数据中心](~~31837~~)。
descriptions.en:
- To list all data redundancy type conversion tasks for a bucket, you must have the `oss:ListBucketDataRedundancyTransition` permission. For more information, see [Grant a custom authorization policy to a RAM user](~~199058~~).
- Each region has a corresponding endpoint. For more information about the mappings between regions and endpoints, see [Endpoints and data centers](~~31837~~).
